record.description_evidence:
Feel confident, even if it’s your first time. Meet your supportive AI companion, AI Thinkin.

About AI Thinkin

If you’ve ever thought, “AI sounds complicated…”

AI Thinkin is a friendly AI assistant you can use just by talking to it. No complicated steps. No technical knowledge required. At your own pace, through simple conversation, it helps make your everyday life a little easier.

What You Can Do

AI Thinkin isn’t just a one-purpose app. It’s a companion you can use however you need, whenever you need it.

You don’t have to decide on a specific use. Just say whatever’s on your mind.

For example:

For conversation
Casual chats
Venting
A quick mental refresh
Organizing your thoughts

For calculations
Splitting a bill
Budgeting
Percentages
Adding tax
Double-checking your math (“Does this look right?”)

For quizzes and brain training
Fun trivia to pass the time
Choose your difficulty or topic
Get explanations with answers

For writing
Polished, professional messages
Shorter phrasing
Rewording
Draft writing

For organizing your tasks
Prioritizing
Figuring out “What should I start with?”

Whether it’s “What should I do in this situation?” or “Hey, can I run something by you?” — AI Thinkin is here for you.

Points-Based System

With AI Thinkin, you can earn points by watching ads and use those points to access AI features.

It’s designed to be easy to try — perfect if you just want to test it out or prefer to use it only when you need it.

Recommended For People Who:

Have little to no experience using AI
Want to try talking to AI without a specific goal in mind
Want quick help with calculations or double-checking things
Enjoy quizzes and brain games
Want help organizing their thoughts or writing

Make your everyday life a little easier — with AI Thinkin by your side.

Take control of your money with Sofi.

Sofi transforms your everyday financial chaos into clarity. It automatically converts bank notifications, receipts, invoices, and bills into clean, organized transactions, so you always know where your money is going.

No spreadsheets. No manual tracking. Just real-time financial insight.

Managing your finances with Sofi is simple:
• Connect one or multiple email accounts.
• Sofi securely processes bank notifications, receipts, invoices, and bills.
• Expenses and income are automatically extracted and recorded as transactions.

You can also create transactions manually or use Sofi’s AI assistant via chat to register them in seconds.

Understand your money at a glance with Sofi’s statistics dashboard, featuring interactive charts, real-time insights, and clear visibility into your spending habits and trends.

DESIGNED FOR YOU
Sofi includes dark mode, supports all currencies and countries worldwide, is available in English and Spanish, and offers Premium Monthly and Premium Annual subscriptions.

Manage Your Amazon Seller Central account with the Amazon Seller App on the go. Stay up-to-date of your orders, inventory, advertising campaigns, and sales, even when you're away from your computer. This app is an essential companion for millions of sellers on Amazon.

Key Features:
- Analyze Sales: Drill down into product-level sales data; and track your store traffic, sales, and conversion trends over time.
 
- Find Profitable Products: Leverage visual search, barcode scanning, and data insights to discover new products to sell.
 
- List New Products: Create new offers or add new products to your Amazon catalog.

- Monitor Account Health: Stay informed on the health of your Amazon seller account and take actions to address issues.
 
- Manage Sponsored Advertising Campaigns: Monitor your campaign impressions, sales, and conversions; Make adjustments to campaign budget and keywords.
 
- Respond to Customers: Use customizable templates to quickly reply to customer messages.
 
- Create Listing Photos: Capture and edit high-quality product photos right from your mobile device.
 
- Have a question about selling on Amazon? Use the app to contact Seller Support.
 
With the Amazon Seller app, you can monitor and streamline operations, make informed decisions, and grow your Amazon business anywhere.

iOS 16.4+

record.name: AgScout.ai Mobile
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The Scout Gen 6 is AgScout’s latest crop evaluation solution, optimized for the 2026 growing season. It offers a suite of advanced features designed to enhance vineyard management through precise, data-driven insights:

- Inventory & Plant Mapping: Automates vine counts and vineyard mapping, providing GPS-tagged data on productive vines, blanks, and rootstocks. This foundational data aids in accurate budgeting, auditing, and planning for vineyard development projects.

- Plant Performance Monitoring: Utilizes AI-powered vision to assess canopy development metrics such as shoot length, canopy volume, and uniformity. Early detection of underperforming vines and low-vigor zones enables targeted canopy management decisions.

- Fruit and Yield Performance: Captures detailed fruit zone data and cluster metrics, facilitating improved yield forecasting and identification of low-performing vines.

- Health Performance Analysis: Calculates health scores for each block, detecting symptomatic vines affected by issues like red blotch and leaf roll viruses, and maintains virus tracking and mapping.

- Insights and Action Plans: Transforms operational and agronomic data into strategic insights, identifying areas for improvement and facilitating informed decision-making.

Additionally, the Mobile Field Notes feature allows for in-field observations, guided sampling, and virus testing, enhancing real-time data collection and responsiveness.
Overall, Scout Gen 6 empowers vineyard managers with precise, actionable data to optimize vineyard performance and productivity.

Scout Mobile integrates with RTK GPS for precise in field plant mapping.

OneSoil is a farm management app that helps you understand what is happening in your fields, plan fieldwork, and keep your team aligned.
Use satellite imagery, vegetation and moisture data, field-level weather, scouting notes, and field history to make better decisions throughout the season.
Whether you manage a few fields or a large farm operation, OneSoil helps you monitor crops, spot problems early, plan operations, and keep all field data in one place.

UNDERSTAND WHAT’S HAPPENING IN EVERY FIELD
Monitor crop development with satellite imagery, NDVI, moisture layers, and field history.
Compare field conditions over time, identify weaker zones, and decide where to scout first.

SPOT PROBLEMS EARLY
Track changes in vegetation and moisture to detect potential stress before it becomes visible from the road.
Use field layers and season history to understand whether a problem is new, recurring, or linked to specific zones in the field.

ADD AND ORGANIZE FIELDS FAST
Find and add fields in seconds with auto-detected field boundaries.
Organize fields by season and workspace, keep boundaries up to date, and manage all your fields without drawing everything manually.

SCOUT FIELDS AND SAVE OBSERVATIONS
Create scouting notes directly from the field, even offline.
Attach photos, mark problem areas, save geolocation, and keep observations connected to the right field, crop, and season.

PLAN OPERATIONS WITH FIELD-LEVEL WEATHER
Plan spraying, fertilization, scouting, and other fieldwork using weather data for each field — not just the nearest town.
Check precipitation maps, field-level forecasts, wind, humidity, temperature, and spraying windows to choose better timing for operations.

KEEP ALL FIELD DATA IN ONE PLACE
Store field boundaries, satellite images, vegetation history, moisture layers, weather, notes, photos, seasons, and field records in one app.
Use OneSoil as a single workspace for your farm data throughout the season.

COLLABORATE WITH YOUR TEAM
Share field context with agronomists, operators, consultants, or farm managers.
Work together in one workspace so everyone can see the same fields, notes, and updates.

START FREE. UPGRADE WHEN YOU NEED ADVANCED TOOLS.

WEB VERSION FOR ADVANCED PRECISION AGRICULTURE
Use OneSoil on mobile and web to get even more from your field data.
The web version supports advanced workflows such as productivity zones, variable-rate prescription maps, soil sampling, machinery data, and yield analysis.

SeedCounter uses advanced AI object detection to count seeds quickly and accurately.

  How it works:
  Simply point your camera at seeds and get an instant count. Use real-time mode for continuous counting or photo mode for single
  captures.

  Key Features:
  - Real-time seed detection and counting
  - Photo mode for single image analysis
  - Cumulative counting for large quantities (300+ seeds)
  - Save and manage results in your album
  - Share counting results with others

  Who is it for?
  - Farmers and agricultural professionals
  - Seed researchers and lab technicians
  - Quality control inspectors
  - Anyone who needs to count seeds fast

  SeedCounter Premium:
